description.value:
Craft Cost 4 Vitae Points

Activate 1 action to fire

An attack-roll shell, no save: 7d10 piercing damage that ignores 5 Hardness or resistance. A critical hit lodges persistent bleed 2d8.

cinderfall.incomplete: The stated fixed damage (7d10 piercing, ignoring 5 Hardness/resistance, no save) has no rule-element or dedicated-field equivalent: this is a type:"ammo" item, and Foundry's ammo schema only modifies a fired weapon's own Strike (damage die/type, traits) -- it has no field to override the Strike's damage formula, force a Hardness/resistance bypass, or add a separate critical-hit effect (persistent bleed 2d8), confirmed against real pf2e's own explosive-ammo pattern (Bomb Launcher, pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/bomb-launcher.json). Unlike the AoE-with-save ammo cards in equipment/ammunition/, this shell is a plain attack-roll item with no save to omit -- what's missing is the fixed damage override, the Hardness-ignoring clause, and the crit persistent bleed, none of which ammo's own schema can carry.
